title: Landmark
wikitext:
A [[landmark]] is an unofficial term for a notable area, building, construction, terrain, settlement, village, or other point of interest that is situated within a [[location]] (mostly [[explorable area]]s). Some of these landmarks are marked with [[signpost]]s or other [[interactive object]]s. 

==Trivia==
*[[Wayfarer's Reverie]] quests require visiting several landmarks.
